setRuns.approved: Approved. The exam is in the list below as "Coming soon".
setRuns.approveTitle: Approve the whole set of run #{id}?
setRuns.approveBody: Every Teil of this run goes into the bank and is assembled into one exam marked "Coming soon". Students do not see it until you press Publish in the exam list. The listening part is taken unchanged from a live hand-written exam, because listening cannot be generated yet.
setRuns.title: Generate an exam set automatically
setRuns.body: The system picks topics, fetches sources, writes texts, creates items, self-checks and self-repairs every Teil of a telc B1 set. The run uses the AI channel selected under "Generate with" and takes about an hour. You only review once the whole set is done.
setRuns.oneAtATime: A run is in progress. Wait for it to finish before starting another.
setRuns.discardBody: Unapproved drafts of this run will be discarded. Articles already used are not returned to the source ledger.
setRuns.recheckedReady: The set now meets the conditions. Press “Approve whole set” once you have reviewed it.
setRuns.recheckedStill: The set still has failing items. See the updated list below.

gate.title: Conditions to approve the whole set
gate.checks: No red set-level check ({red} red now)
gate.next: After fixing the stuck Teile, press “Re-check set”. A Teil with no red light counts as done and the set-level checks run again; when both conditions hold the run moves to “Awaiting approval” and the “Approve whole set” button appears. Yellow items do not block approval.

fix.title: Why it is stuck and how to fix it
fix.noProblems: The draft has no red items left. Press “Re-check set” at the top of the run.
fix.step2: Red item: edit the question, options or answer by hand, or regenerate just that item. Red light on the text: edit the passage named or have it rewritten.
fix.step3: Go to the Check step and run the self-check again. The machine has used all its repair rounds, so this time you decide.
fix.step4: Come back here and press “Re-check set”.
fix.done: After the latest self-check the draft has no red light at all: neither Teil-level lights nor any item. Yellow lights may remain.

sources.intro: Publishers the exam-set pipeline may use. "Read new articles" only collects the article list (title, link); it does not download articles. Each article is used once.

ADAPT.title: May be adapted
ADAPT.body: Licence allows changes and commercial use. Articles are downloaded, rewritten to level and credited with "bearbeitet".

FACTS_ONLY.title: Facts only
FACTS_ONLY.body: Articles are downloaded only to extract figures and facts; a completely new text is written.

TOPIC_ONLY.title: Topic hints
TOPIC_ONLY.body: Copyrighted news outlets. Only feed headlines are read to see which topics are current; articles are never downloaded.

blueprintKind.ARTICLE: From the blueprint: Lesen Teil 2 B1 has {itemCount} a/b/c items and a 300–450 word text.
blueprintKind.MATCH_HEADLINE: From the blueprint: Lesen Teil 1 B1 has {itemCount} short texts (55–110 words each) and 10 headlines a–j — one correct headline per text, the other 5 are distractors.

blueprintKind.GAP_MC: Sprachbausteine Teil 1 B1: one letter with {itemCount} gaps (21–30), a/b/c for each gap.
blueprintKind.GAP_WORDBANK: Sprachbausteine Teil 2 B1: an ad + a letter with {itemCount} gaps (31–40), a box of 15 words a–o (5 spare).
blueprintKind.WRITE_EMAIL: Schreiben B1: an informal (du) e-mail (70–130 words) and 4 guiding points; no items.
blueprintKind.MC_INFO: Lesen Teil 1 A2: an information board (8–14 lines) and {itemCount} situations, a/b/c each.
blueprintKind.TRUE_FALSE: Lesen Teil 2 A2: an e-mail or short text and {itemCount} richtig/falsch statements (6–10).
blueprintKind.MATCH_AD_X_A2: Lesen Teil 3 A2: {itemCount} situations (11–15) and 8 ads a–h (10–35 words each); exactly 1 situation is x, 1 example.
blueprintKind.FILL_FORM: Schreiben Teil 1 A2: a text about a person and a form with {itemCount} fields, 1 point each.
blueprintKind.WRITE_NOTE: Schreiben Teil 2 A2: a situation + 4 points, students pick 3, about 40 words, 10 points; no items.
